claim_boundary: This protocol fixes only an induced-response reduced KKT gate for the V0 atomic-displacement tangent. Its synthetic unit controls prove source/dual and common-scalar algebra. They do not use a physical continuum run, permanent solute density, gas energy, nonpolar functional, force, PES, experimental solvation label, total solvation prediction, or chemistry accuracy metric.

construction.name: route2-v0-atomic-displacement-reduced-kkt-v1
construction.source: B_R is assembled column-by-column from the frozen V0-ADT free-atom translation-tangent potential at the exact continuum surface points; its transpose B_R^T is the only surface-charge-to-dipole dual.
construction.electronic_term: 0.5 p^T alpha_theta(R)^-1 p, where alpha_theta is a raw frozen positive molecular polarizability in bohr^3 and p is the induced molecular dipole in e bohr.
construction.continuum_term: 0.5 (B_R p)^T Q_R (B_R p), where Q_R is the declared energy-conjugate reciprocal surface response.
construction.external_term: p^T f in the explicitly declared external dipole-dual convention.
construction.stationarity: K_R p + f = 0 with K_R=alpha_theta^-1+B_R^T Q_R B_R; the continuum surface state has been eliminated, so this is a reduced KKT system rather than the final joint density/surface KKT system.

required_structural_gates: The atomic dipole partition sums to the molecular dipole identity and the direct V0-ADT surface map is finite.
The reported source dual is the exact transpose of that same surface map: q^T B_R p = p^T B_R^T q.
The supplied polarizability is reciprocal and positive definite before inversion; material asymmetry or nonpositive curvature is a rejection, not an opportunity to repair the tensor.
The declared continuum has matching atomic numbers, geometry, and surface points, and B_R^T Q_R B_R is reciprocal in the V0-ADT source subspace.
Both electronic curvature and K_R are strictly positive definite under frozen relative thresholds.

The returned state independently recomputes surface potential, continuum dual, stationarity residual, half-coupling energy ledger, inverse-Hessian response, reciprocity, passivity, and the external-dual finite-difference identity.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not use the rejected one-radial MACE l=1 Gaussian source.
Do not change the V0-ADT radial table, select a width, rescale polarizability, add error-selected multipoles, or choose a continuum/cavity from a solvation error.
Do not promote the reduced induced-only scalar to a permanent-density functional, a MACE-MDP energy, a total solvation free energy, or a force model.
Do not run a FreeSolv, MNSol, or other experimental accuracy panel from this structural gate.
physical_binding_required_before_any_acc: Identity-bound frozen MACE-MDP polarizability and V0-ADT source at each preregistered geometry.
A physical reciprocal continuum execution with a source/dual and smooth-coordinate certificate.
Twelve-record, ten-functional-group QM density/MEP/reaction-potential physics gates that read no experimental solvation label.
A full permanent-density/source-dual and joint electronic-continuum stationary functional, or an explicit rejection of V0-ADT in favor of the separately source-bound V0-RK route.
Envelope-force and runtime gates before immutable multi-solvent and blind experimental validation.
decision_rule: A failed gate rejects the current frozen physical binding. No failed structural, physical, force, runtime, or chemistry gate authorizes fitting, retraining, calibration, damping, clipping, radius tuning, or a post-hoc correction.
